about.title: About AtelierBag OEM | Guangzhou Handbag Factory
about.heroDescription: A Shiling, Guangzhou handbag OEM and ODM partner for brands that want a factory conversation—not only a catalogue.
about.workflowDescription:
AtelierBag Manufacturing Co., Ltd. has built handbag OEM programs from Shiling, Huadu, Guangzhou since 2008. We work with leather, vegan alternatives, and textile constructions across tote, shoulder, crossbody, backpack, and small-leather-goods lines.

Buyers work with us when materials, pattern, and packing need to stay in the same conversation.
about.story:
AtelierBag Manufacturing Co., Ltd. has built handbag OEM programs from Shiling, Huadu, Guangzhou since 2008. We work with leather, vegan alternatives, and textile constructions across tote, shoulder, crossbody, backpack, and small-leather-goods lines.

factory.title: Factory & Capabilities | AtelierBag OEM
factory.description: Handbag OEM capabilities in Shiling, Guangzhou: materials, development, production, QC, packing, and logistics.
factory.content: AtelierBag OEM runs full-package handbag programs from Shiling, Huadu. The pages below cover materials, development, production, QC, packing, and logistics.

sections.title: What this factory owns
sections.body: Development, cutting, stitching, finishing, QC, and packing sit in one commercial thread.
items: Materials Sourcing — leather, vegan, and textile options named on the BOM.
Product Development — pattern, prototype, and style development.
OEM & ODM Production — your design or a workshop-led development.
Process Control & QC — in-line checks and a pre-shipment review.
Packaging & Branding — logo, packing, and carton marks.
Global Logistics — export packing and shipping documents.

factory/materials-sourcing.title: Materials Sourcing
factory/materials-sourcing.description: Leather, vegan alternatives, and textiles for handbag OEM programs.
factory/materials-sourcing.content:
Materials are named on the BOM before a sample is cut: genuine leather, coated alternatives, recycled or textile faces, linings, and hardware.

Restricted-substance and animal-origin rules can be confirmed before the first face is cut.

factory/product-development.title: Product Development
factory/product-development.description: Pattern, prototype, and style development for OEM and ODM handbags.
factory/product-development.content:
Development starts from an approved design, a sketch, or a physical reference. We check measurements, construction, and hardware, then cut a prototype for handle drop, pocket logic, and finishing.

Comments stay on the same sheet so bulk follows the signed sample.

factory/oem-odm.title: OEM & ODM Production
factory/oem-odm.description: OEM from your design or ODM from a workshop-led silhouette.
factory/oem-odm.content:
OEM programs follow your approved design. ODM programs start from a workshop silhouette you can mark up. Either path locks materials and measurements before the line opens.

Opening quantities depend on construction and hardware. We confirm them after we review the style.

factory/process-control.title: Process Control & QC
factory/process-control.description: In-line checks and pre-shipment review for handbag bulk orders.
factory/process-control.content:
QC is written as checkpoints: incoming materials, in-line stitch and edge work, and a final review before packing. We can follow your AQL or a factory checklist you accept in the PO.

Photo notes can travel with the shipment when the order asks for them.

factory/packaging-branding.title: Packaging & Branding
factory/packaging-branding.description: Logo methods, packing, and carton marks for brand programs.
factory/packaging-branding.content:
Logo options include deboss, foil, metal plate, and printed labels—confirmed against the material. Packing follows the brand sheet: dust bags, cards, polybags, and carton marks.

Artwork can be confirmed during sampling so branding is not left to the end.

factory/logistics.title: Global Logistics
factory/logistics.description: Export packing and shipping documents from Guangzhou.
factory/logistics.content:
We pack for sea or air from South China and prepare the documents your forwarder names on the order. Carton size and weight are confirmed after the packing method is locked.

Freight is arranged by you or a named forwarder; we coordinate packing so that quote is straightforward.

custom-process.title: Custom Process | Sample to Shipment
custom-process.description: How AtelierBag OEM moves a handbag from enquiry to bulk shipment.
custom-process.content: A custom program follows one written sequence: review, sample, then bulk after sign-off. QC and packing sit before documents go to the forwarder.

sections.title: Six steps
sections.body: Sample and bulk windows are confirmed after we see the construction.
items: Review the style — design, measurements, and materials.
Pattern & material confirmation — leather or alternative, lining, hardware.
Prototype / sample — fit, handle drop, finishing.
Bulk production — after sample and material lock.
QC & packing — in-line and final, then brand packing.
Shipping & documents — export cartons and papers.

warranty-policy.title: Factory tour | AtelierBag OEM
warranty-policy.description: Ask for a virtual walk-through of the Shiling handbag workshop.
warranty-policy.content:
A virtual factory tour is a scheduled call or photo set covering cutting, stitching, finishing, and packing. Write to sales@atelierbag-oem.com or use the quote form so we can prepare the right line.

On-site visits in Shiling are by appointment.

faq.title: FAQ | AtelierBag OEM
faq.description: Common questions on MOQ, sampling, materials, and quotes.
faq.content: Short answers for buyers looking at a handbag OEM.

sections.title: Ordering
sections.body: Quotes are written per program, not from a published price list.
items: What is your MOQ? — Opening quantities depend on construction and hardware. We confirm them after we review the style.
How do I get a factory quote? — Use Get Factory Quote or write to sales@atelierbag-oem.com.
Do you keep a published price list? — Quotes are written per program. Several styles can sit in one enquiry.

sections.title: Sampling & materials
sections.body: Samples lock the style before bulk.
items: How do we start a sample? — A short enquiry is enough. A style reference can travel with it if you already have one.
Leather or vegan? — Both, plus textile faces. Animal-origin and restricted-substance rules can be confirmed before sampling.
How long does sampling take? — We confirm the window after pattern and material review.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How AtelierBag OEM handles enquiry data.
privacy.content: AtelierBag OEM uses the contact details you submit to reply to quotes and project briefs. We do not sell enquiry data. To update or delete information you have sent, write to sales@atelierbag-oem.com.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: Terms for using the AtelierBag OEM website.
terms.content: Content on this website is for product information and enquiry only. Specifications, opening quantities, and lead times are confirmed in writing on each quotation. Nothing here is a binding offer. Commercial terms sit on documents issued by AtelierBag Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.description: How AtelierBag OEM packs and hands over export shipments.
shipping.content:
We pack finished goods to the method named on the order and prepare the documents your forwarder lists. Freight itself is arranged by you or a named forwarder unless a quotation says otherwise.

Carton marks, weights, and photo notes are confirmed after packing is locked.
